speech.name: Arrests for "incitement" over posts and teaching
speech.ctx: A school principal in al-Eizariya held with his posters and lessons cited as evidence.

speech.name: Troops in two Tuqu' classrooms
speech.ctx: Flags taken during the first lesson; staff and pupils threatened with closure.

speech.name: Prisoners' legal files carried off in Ramallah
speech.ctx: Addameer's sealed office emptied onto a military trailer.

speech.name: Home-camera footage seized in a raid
speech.ctx: Soldiers searched homes and left with the recordings.

speech.name: Arab lists back on the ballot
speech.ctx: The Supreme Court overturned the bans on Ra'am and the Joint List before the 27 October vote.

platforms.name: Digital violations logged in three months
platforms.ctx: 194 cases of incitement against Palestinians left online, 114 of Palestinian posts restricted.

platforms.name: Palestinian posts suppressed on Meta since 2023
platforms.ctx: Cited in the UN Special Rapporteur's report to the General Assembly.

platforms.name: Anas al-Sharif's war archive taken off Instagram
platforms.ctx: The killed correspondent's account was shut; Meta has given no reason.

platforms.name: WhatsApp call to block olive pickers
platforms.ctx: A "Stop the Harvest" poster told settlers to gather near Neve Daniel before dawn.

platforms.name: The Al Jazeera law, extended
platforms.ctx: Now reaches websites and YouTube channels, with no court approval needed.

creators.name: Concrete Land wins the Grierson Award
creators.ctx: Asmahan Bkerat's debut documentary, filmed over eight years, at the London Film Festival.

creators.name: Gaza reporting takes four Bayeux prizes
creators.ctx: Mahmoud Abu Hamda won the jury's and the public's photo prizes.

creators.name: Saleh al-Jafarawi, a year on
creators.ctx: Shot dead in Gaza City days after the ceasefire; no investigation result found.

creators.name: A Gaza football photo, put back by a court
creators.ctx: Deauville removed Jehad Alshrafi's picture; a court in Caen ordered it returned.

press.ctx: Saleh Shawka of the Democratic Media Forum, taken from his home after a search.
